choices: Ramps generated in OKLCH from foundations/tokens/palette.config.json; step 600 reaches 4.5:1 with white on every hue, step 500 reaches 3:1 on white.
Neutral is a slate (OKLCH hue 255, chroma 0.012). Accent is blue; info blue, success green, warning amber, danger red.

Semantic palette color.palette.{neutral,accent,info,success,warning,danger}.<step> in common.tokens.json: the six ramps the roles reference, each an alias to a primitive ramp, so a brand changes its accent with 11 aliases (the theme-builder overlay format). Renamed from color.ramp after review round 1.
Primitives are literal (radius and shadows included); semantic colors are aliases only; both enforced by tooling/check-foundations.ts.

Line-height primitives are named (none, tight, snug, normal, relaxed, loose) because dotted numbers cannot be path segments; tracking adds tighter (-1px) for display sizes and is the only negative dimension family.
Dark mode expresses elevation with lighter neutrals (canvas 950, default 900, subtle 800, muted 700, overlay 800); neutral solid actions invert (light surface, dark content).
Field borders use neutral 500 so that they reach 3:1 on the default surface.
Brands: brick (orange accent, radii xs/sm/md) and orchid (violet accent, radii xl/2xl/2xl).
Typography composites carry letterSpacing and optional fontFeatures (OpenType tags); CSS exposes --ggb-typography-<role>-letterSpacing and -fontFeatureSettings; the Figma manifest carries both.
